maddeler.e:
أحتجز (form VIII)
# أَحْتَجِزُ (ʔaḥtajizu) /ʔaħ.ta.d͡ʒi.zu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
# أُحْتَجَزُ (ʔuḥtajazu) /ʔuħ.ta.d͡ʒa.zu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
# أَحْتَجِزَ (ʔaḥtajiza) /ʔaħ.ta.d͡ʒi.za/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
# أُحْتَجَزَ (ʔuḥtajaza) /ʔuħ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
